title: Tusk's Vault
description:
Ask your campaign's own lore from the chat bar. Type /tusk who is the harbour master? and the answer comes back cited to the note it came from, rather than to a model's guess about a generic fantasy world. Players install nothing.

Lite works the moment you enable this module, with nothing else installed. It answers from the journal entries in the folders you point it at, and cites the page it used so you can click through and check. Optionally it reads Foundry's own journal ownership per player, so two people asking the same question are answered from the notes each of them can open.

Bridge is the other mode, and the one that needs a separate program. It connects this module to Tusk's Vault — a free, self-hosted app the GM runs on their own computer, which Foundry cannot install for you. Answers then come from everything you keep, Word and PDF and Markdown and a whole Obsidian vault, instead of one journal folder — with your choice of model, and an API key that never sits in a browser.

Start with Lite; move up when you want more. Setup, tutorials and troubleshooting: kochitusker.github.io/Tusks-Vault · source on GitHub
